'''Volgh Leader''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by a certain [[Hapan]] [[Unidentified Volgh Leader|pilot]] during the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] of the [[New Jedi Order]] from the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], after the [[Jedi academy|academy]] came under attack by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].<ref name="apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
